note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The initial version and the proposed modification are supplied values of this example, shown with equal weight; the proposal is only proposed (never shown as approved or rejected), the earlier text stays readable in the change history, and nothing states a rule for amending (permission, time limits, admissibility) or any effect. The inspected datum is only the day supplied for the proposed modification; changing it changes nothing else.
